name: Steward ACS — server
description: Host CPU/memory/disk/network (OTel hostmetrics) plus BEAM vm.metrics from the ACS Events dataset.

query.mpl:
__METRICS_DATASET__:`system.cpu.utilization`
| where state != "idle" and state != "interrupt" and state != "nice"
| align to 1m using avg
| group by state using avg

__METRICS_DATASET__:`system.memory.utilization`
| where state == "used"
| align to 1m using avg
| group using avg

__METRICS_DATASET__:`system.cpu.load_average.1m`
| align to 1m using avg
| group using avg

__METRICS_DATASET__:`system.filesystem.utilization`
| align to 1m using avg
| group by mountpoint using avg

__METRICS_DATASET__:`system.network.io`
| align to 1m using prom::rate
| group by device, direction using sum

query.apl:
['__EVENTS_DATASET__']
| where ['message'] == "vm.metrics"
| summarize avg_memory=avg(['memory_total_bytes']), avg_sched=avg(['scheduler_utilization']) by bin(_time, 1m)
